capabilities: Show today's planned workout on a dashboard
Log sets with a rep counter or a timed circuit
Browse an exercise library with images and muscle maps
Track goals, personal records and body stats
Write workouts, plans and stats as plain notes
disambiguation: Not a ready-made vault of notes; it is a plugin that adds a training dashboard and logger to your own vault.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.0 or newer; beta builds are installed through BRAT. Makes network requests to raw.githubusercontent.com for the plan library and starter images, and to wger.de for some demonstration media; an offline image download option is provided. No account, telemetry or server.
problem: Training plans, workout logs and body measurements usually live in a separate app or account instead of in the vault next to other notes.

relations.evidence: The music button opens Spotify or Apple Music in a new window only when you tap it
Settings → Playlists lets you save Spotify or Apple Music share links to start from that button
Install the BRAT plugin, then Add beta plugin and enter RuanPienaarCode/Gym-Vault

summary: Training dashboard and logger that keeps plans, an exercise library, workout history, goals and body stats as plain notes in the vault.
